facts.label: Nome e uso
facts.sub: Use is called para o nome e is used for + -ing para a função: It is called a compass. It is used for finding the way.

facts.label: Chama-se
facts.sub: Use is called para dar o nome: It is called a compass. Para vários objetos, use are called: They are called stars. Para perguntar, diga What is it called? e responda It is called…

facts.label: É usado para
facts.sub: Use is used for para dizer a função: A telescope is used for looking at the stars. Depois de for, use o verbo com -ing: finding, writing, learning. Para vários, use are used for.

pages.title: A museum · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Saturday morning in a museum in Los Angeles. Old things sit behind clean glass. Dirk works as a guide here. A visitor, Ben, walks in with his camera. He looks at the first table. Dirk walks over to help.
“Hi, Ben! Welcome to the museum of old things.” says Dirk. “Thanks! What is this round thing called?” says Ben. “It is called a compass. It is used for finding the way.” says Dirk.
